title: P97-B slashed from DPWH budget in Senate appropriations bill
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Approximately P97 billion was slashed from the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in the Senate 2027 General Appropriations Bill, Sen. JV Ejercito said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Approximately P97 billion was slashed from the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in the Senate 2027 General Appropriations Bill, Sen. JV Ejercito said on Friday. Ejercito, head of the Senate finance panel, revealed the budget cut after he filed on Friday afternoon Senate Committee Report No. 131. “P97 billion worth of projects were deleted from the DPWH budget. Ito po ang resulta ng pag-scrutinize ng Senate the past few weeks,” Ejercito said in a press briefing. (P97 billion worth of projects were deleted from the DPWH budget.
